correctness.rationale: For n>=3, the four zero gaps are uniquely defined. Direct subsequence counting proves equivalence of full decks to equality of N, A=011, B=110 and F=001, because all eight entries are explicit functions of these. Equality of N,A,B forces gap difference t(1,-3,3,-1); direct binomial expansion gives F difference t(x2-x1+3t), so a nontrivial equal-deck partner exists iff t=(x1-x2)/3 is integral, nonzero and yields nonnegative gaps. This quadratic has at most one nonzero root, proving classes are of size at most 2. Positive orientation gives the unique gap parametrization (r,s+3t,s,t+u) and (r+t,s,s+3t,u), r,s,u>=0,t>=1, establishing the rational gf. Coefficient extraction and singularity analysis give claimed asymptotics. The embedded verifier directly computes decks on all words up to n=24 and independently counts involution pairs up to n=100. The general proof does not depend on finite checks.

originality.rationale: The all-length proof and involutive fiber classification are not among the inspected published theorems. The 2021 source expressly puts the identical rational generating function forward as Conjecture 1, validated there only for twenty coefficients; this is an explicit acknowledgement of prior conjecture and does not imply a proof. Its Section 5.3 contains a zero-gap nullspace and a collision inequality, but not the quadratic-root equality classification. The September 2026 paper proves asymptotic degrees-of-freedom results for all compositions, not this exact weight-three count. Comparisons with published mathematical research records did not disclose a covering result; absence of hits alone is not proof of priority.
residual_risks: An earlier unindexed proof of Chrisnata et al. Conjecture 1 might exist outside searchable material.
The earlier conjectured equation is identical as a formula; priority of the equation belongs to its original authors, while novelty is claimed only for the proof and explicit involution.
The finite verifier cannot replace the algebraic all-length argument.

value.rationale: The theorem supplies an all-length proof of an explicit open generating-function conjecture in the exact fixed-weight k-deck reconstruction problem, plus a complete classification of every ambiguous pair. The weight-three case is the first binary 3-deck composition where collisions occur (length seven), so the setting is intrinsically motivated, not an arbitrary computational slice. The asymptotic fraction 3/4 of individually reconstructible words quantifies reconstruction limits under short scattered-read multiplicities. It does not purport to resolve unrestricted k-deck enumeration.
